question: The detector trained only on ordinary text-to-speech. If it also trains on one voice-cloning tool (Chatterbox), does it catch copies made by a different cloning tool it has never heard (XTTS)?
version_4: Version 3 plus 800 training clips of Chatterbox copying real training speakers. Same layer, same training conditions (clean, phone, aug1, aug2), same alarm-level rule.
main_comparison: Version 4 against version 3, phone line: XTTS copies caught (my voice and new speakers), and my real voice wrongly flagged.
also_reported: Version 2 with the same extra clips; Chatterbox copies of my voice (a tool now trained on); the earlier never-seen test clips, as a repeat look.
